svg.title: Separation temperatures of the same lattice alloy from three models
svg.desc: Composition against kT/epsilon. Red region: regular-solution miscibility gap, peak at 2.00, with the A2 roots 0.145 and 0.855 at kT = 1.6 epsilon. Blue region: exact square-lattice coexistence from Onsager and Yang, peak at 1.13. Dashed grey: two-extremes estimate 1.44.
